description: Create vercel.json configuration file and rename frontend API client from php.ts to api.ts with generic backend support. Update all import references.
steps: Create vercel.json at project root with the exact configuration specified: framework vite, buildCommand pnpm build, outputDirectory dist, installCommand pnpm install, security headers (X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-XSS-Protection 1; mode=block, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin), cache headers for /assets/ (public max-age=31536000 immutable), and SPA rewrites excluding assets/icons/manifest.json/favicon.svg.

Create src/services/api.ts as a renamed and refactored version of src/services/php.ts. Change: (1) use VITE_API_URL env var instead of VITE_PHP_API_URL, (2) rename class from PhpApiClient to ApiClient, (3) rename export from phpApi to api, (4) keep all existing method signatures exactly the same (generateInvoice, generatePO, generateStockReport, sendEmail, sendWhatsApp, importExcel, exportInventory, uploadFile), (5) keep JWT forwarding from Supabase session.
Update src/services/excel/routing.ts to import { api } from '@/services/api' instead of { phpApi } from '@/services/php'. Replace all phpApi usages with api.
Update src/services/sales/fulfillment.ts to import { api } from '@/services/api' instead of { phpApi } from '@/services/php'. Replace all phpApi usages with api.
Update src/services/sales/invoices.ts to import { api } from '@/services/api' instead of { phpApi } from '@/services/php'. Replace all phpApi usages with api.

Update .env.example to add VITE_API_URL=https://stockflow-api.your-subdomain.workers.dev under a new comment section '# Backend API (Cloudflare Worker in production, PHP locally)'. Keep the existing VITE_PHP_API_URL line but mark it as deprecated with a comment.
acceptance_criteria: vercel.json exists at project root with the exact structure specified in requirements
src/services/api.ts exports an api instance of ApiClient class using VITE_API_URL
All files that previously imported from @/services/php now import from @/services/api
pnpm build succeeds without TypeScript errors
verification: Run pnpm type-check to confirm no TypeScript errors
Run pnpm build to confirm the frontend builds successfully
